description: Archive a page (or restore it with `archived: false`). An archived page is kept, with its history, and hidden from the page tree and search. Only call when the person asked for it.

archived.description: true to archive (default), false to restore.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_archive_page
title: Archive page
